author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell hands it over to nurse Nikki for this week's nurses with verses segment, where she shares Psalm 107 and how it spoke to her about being redeemed and having chains broken apart. She explains how remembering her identity in Christ helps her step away from fear and anxiety instead of trying to solve everything on her own. Russell adds a thoughtful note on fear, that what we're often really afraid of isn't the thing itself, but losing our grip on our own state of mind. A gentle, grounding moment for anyone feeling weighed down by fear or anxiety this week.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell speaks with a doctor about the majority of patients who died in 2020, arguing that most would have made a full recovery if they had simply been supported rather than given morphine and midazolam. He's careful to note this isn't about blaming doctors and nurses following procedure, but about how that procedure created the impression that Covid was uniquely lethal, justifying lockdowns and rushed, untested vaccines. The chilling detail is that neither of those measures would have done anything to stop a midazolam overdose in the first place. A sobering look at what may have actually driven the death toll during the pandemic's worst months.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell argues that powers exist so great they can decide outcomes before an election even happens, if one candidate wins we do this, if another wins we do that, calling that the true horror behind modern politics. He insists his position doesn't change no matter who's on the ballot, Trump, Harris, Macron, or anyone else, because without a significant systemic shift, elections just become arguments over the personalities presiding over the same destructive path. Russell's answer is that today's technology, digital ID, facial recognition, mass biometrics, can either be used for total control or for true participatory democracy, and he believes the latter is the only real way to end continual war. A bold argument for rethinking where real power should sit.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell's guest reveals they had no idea the US was working with China on the creation of a coronavirus at the Wuhan Institute of Virology, alongside efforts to develop a vaccine at the same time. They point to a 2017 event held by Johns Hopkins and the Gates Foundation called the Spurs Pandemic, which predicted a coronavirus pandemic coming out of China and mapped out vaccination as the primary response almost exactly as it later played out. The guest also claims officials were actively discussing how to conceal that the outbreak came from a lab. A jaw dropping account that raises serious questions about how much was known in advance.
